info.title: B2B Regulatory, KYB, FinTech & SecOps MCP Server (30 Tools)
info.description:
Official Master Model Context Protocol (MCP) Server & Tool Router for all 30 B2B Regulatory, KYB, Sanctions AML, SEC EDGAR, SAM.gov, EU TED, UK FCA, Brazil BCB/PIX/Tax, Healthcare & SecOps engines (@b2b-quant-apis) with Freemium Catalog Discovery and x402 Solana USDC integration.

### Enterprise B2B Value Proposition (B2B Regulatory, KYB, FinTech & SecOps MCP Server (30 Tools))
- **Target B2B Buyers:** AI Agent Builders, Enterprise LLM Orchestration Teams, and Multi-Agent FinTech/SecOps Platforms.
- **Zero External API Keys Required:** Connects directly to authoritative government, regulatory, and financial primary registries with built-in retry/backoff and deterministic schema normalization.
- **Quantitative Scoring & RAG Briefs:** Every record is enriched with a quantitative 0-100 risk/viability score and an LLM-ready Markdown executive brief (`MCP Master Router Tool Discovery or Dispatch Executed`).
- **Backend Proxy Secret Injection:** RapidAPI Studio and Zyla API Hub inject `Authorization: Bearer <APIFY_API_TOKEN>` invisibly at the proxy layer when forwarding synchronous calls to `https://api.apify.com/v2/acts/b2b-quant-apis~b2b-quant-mcp-server/run-sync-get-dataset-items`.
- **Marketplace Categories:** RapidAPI `Artificial Intelligence/Machine Learning` | Zyla API Hub `AI & Machine Learning`.
- **Subscription Tiers (USD):** `BASIC` ($0.00/mo, 15 req/mo hard cap), `PRO` ($19.00/mo, 1,000 req/mo + $0.02/extra), `ULTRA` ($49.00/mo, 5,000 req/mo + $0.015/extra), `MEGA` ($149.00/mo, 25,000 req/mo + $0.010/extra).
- **SEO Keywords:** mcp-server, model-context-protocol, ai-agent-tools, b2b-compliance-suite, claude-cursor-tools, langchain-b2b, autonomous-agents.

B2bQuantMcpServerRequest.title: B2B Regulatory, KYB, FinTech & SecOps MCP Server (30 Tools) Request Schema
B2bQuantMcpServerRequest.description: Configure the Master MCP Server operationMode ('list_catalog', 'invoke_tool', or 'export_mcp_config'), target B2B tool name, JSON tool arguments, optional category filter, and optional Apify API token.

operationMode.title: MCP Operation Mode
operationMode.description: Select 'list_catalog' for free instant JSON-RPC 2.0 tools/list discovery of all 30 B2B tools, 'invoke_tool' to dispatch/validate a specific B2B tool call, or 'export_mcp_config' to generate ready-to-paste Claude Desktop, Cursor, Windsurf, and x402 configs.

toolName.title: Target B2B Tool / Actor Slug
toolName.description: Slug or MCP tool name of any of the 30 underlying @b2b-quant-apis engines (e.g., 'us-sec-edgar-filings-insider-radar', 'global-sanctions-pep-interpol-watchlist-screener', 'brazil-b2b-cnpj-qsa-lead-enricher').

toolArguments.title: Tool Call JSON Arguments
toolArguments.description: Structured JSON arguments passed to the target B2B tool when operationMode is 'invoke_tool'.

categoryFilter.title: Catalog Category Filter
categoryFilter.description: Filter the 30 B2B tools by domain category in 'list_catalog' mode ('ALL', 'FINANCE_KYB', 'GOVCON_PROCUREMENT', 'SECOPS_CYBER', 'HEALTHCARE_BIOTECH', 'BRAZIL_B2B_TAX', or 'ESG_LOGISTICS_GEO').

apifyApiToken.title: Apify API Token (Optional for Live Dispatch)
apifyApiToken.description: Optional Apify API Token to execute a live synchronous REST call against the target @b2b-quant-apis Actor during 'invoke_tool'. If omitted, returns a deterministic validated MCP execution envelope.

maxTools.title: Maximum Tools Returned
maxTools.description: Maximum number of B2B tool definitions to return in 'list_catalog' mode (1 to 30).
